# Tunable thermal emissivity with non-volatile switching: A Ge2Sb2Te5-based multilayer film for adaptive camouflage and radiative cooling

**Fanxi Sun, Longtian Xie, Kaihua Zhang, Kun Yu, Yufang Liu**

Fanxi Sun et al., Infrared Physics & Technology 155, 106478 (2026).

[**DOI →**](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.infrared.2026.106478)

## Abstract

Demonstrates a Ge2Sb2Te5-based multilayer film with non-volatile switching of thermal emissivity for adaptive camouflage and radiative cooling.
